high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for an article about Chadwick Boseman's speech at the American Film Institute's (AFI) 47th Life Achievement Award ceremony. The text highlights Boseman's statement, "There is no Black Panther without Denzel Washington," which was delivered during his acceptance speech. Below the text, there is a headline that reads, "Chadwick Boseman's 2019 Speech Makes Black Panther 3 Even More Special," attributed to Screen Rant and Marvel Cinematic Universe. The headline is accompanied by a heart emoji, adding a sentimental tone to the message.
